# SAUDEX GLOBAL

SAUDEX GLOBAL provides freight forwarding and logistics services for businesses. The company lists its office in Singapore and coordinates air, sea, and land freight, customs, warehousing, distribution, and supply chain services.

Contact: [sales@saudexglobal.com](mailto:sales@saudexglobal.com)

## Company

- [About SAUDEX GLOBAL](https://saudexglobal.com/about-us/): Company information and approach to logistics services.
- [Our team](https://saudexglobal.com/team/): Information about the SAUDEX GLOBAL team.
- [Contact](https://saudexglobal.com/contact/): Contact the team about logistics enquiries.
- [Get a quote](https://saudexglobal.com/get-a-quote/): Request a logistics quote.
- [Partnerships](https://saudexglobal.com/be-our-partner/): Partnership information.

## Services

- [Freight forwarding](https://saudexglobal.com/services/freight/): Air, sea, and land freight coordination.
- [Import and export](https://saudexglobal.com/services/import-export/): Import-export coordination and trade documentation.
- [Customs](https://saudexglobal.com/services/customs/): Customs clearance and documentation support.
- [Warehousing](https://saudexglobal.com/services/warehousing/): Warehousing and inventory support.
- [Distribution](https://saudexglobal.com/services/distribution/): Distribution and delivery coordination.
- [FMCG logistics](https://saudexglobal.com/services/fmcg/): Logistics services for fast-moving consumer goods.
- [Supply chain](https://saudexglobal.com/services/supply-chain/): Supply chain logistics and planning support.

## Industries

- [Agriculture](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/agriculture/): Logistics for agriculture businesses.
- [Cold chain](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/cold-chain/): Temperature-controlled logistics.
- [E-commerce](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/e-commerce/): Logistics and fulfilment support for e-commerce.
- [FMCG](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/fmcg-industry/): Logistics for fast-moving consumer goods businesses.
- [Food and beverages](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/food-beverages/): Logistics for food and beverage businesses.
- [HoReCa](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/horeca/): Logistics for hotels, restaurants, and catering businesses.
- [Retail](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/retail/): Logistics for retail and wholesale businesses.
